import json,signal,time,shutil
from performance.complete_historical_source_heads import ROOT,read,save,cpu_timeout
from performance.validate_historical_component_transfer import part_path
from performance.validate_historical_label_groups import prepare

plan='performance/manifests/historical_body_reference_pilot_v1.json';spec=read(plan);out=ROOT/spec['output'];out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(ROOT/'paper_artifacts/historical_label_groups_v1/anchor_costs.json',out/'anchor_costs.json')
selected=read(spec['selection'])['selected'];reused=0.;rows=0
for name in spec['records']:
 for row in selected:
  row=dict(row,record=name)

   source=read(str(part_path(ROOT/'paper_artifacts/historical_cdf_bank_v1',row,h)))
   data=dict(record=name,group=row['group'],kind=row['kind'],identity=h,rows={'E5':source['rows']['E5']})
   path=part_path(out,row,h);path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);save(path,data)
   reused+=source['rows']['E5']['cpu_seconds'];rows+=1

meta=dict(reused_rule_rows=rows,reused_integral_cpu_seconds=reused,total_preparation_cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-start,
 cumulative_estimated_cpu_seconds=work['estimated_cpu_seconds']+480+600,maximum_estimated_cpu_seconds=3600)
assert meta['cumulative_estimated_cpu_seconds']<=3600 and work['estimated_cost_admitted']
save(out/'phase_budget.json',meta);signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_PROF,0.);print('PHASE_BUDGET '+json.dumps(meta))
